hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Tableau palette and mix-blend-mode on links show deliberate choices, but edge bundles are nearly invisible at rendered opacity and the dense circle pack creates visual noise without a clear focal hierarchy.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for size encoding in force layout, data-driven scale domains via d3.extent/root.height, key functions on all data joins; primarily topological so zero-baseline and KDE concerns are N/A.
flags: Update Storm: tension-slider fires redrawLinks() (300 path attr mutations) on every input event with no RAF or debounce; easing-param sliders call updateLayout() triggering a full 1500ms transition on every input pixel

Mid-Flight Snap: no .interrupt() call before creating new transitions at line 498; interrupt handler (line 511) only cancels RAF but never sets current_x/current_y, leaving stale source coordinates for the subsequent transition causing node jumps on rapid layout switching

Mouse-Touch Fight: mouseover/mouseout/click handlers on nodeSelection (lines 650-661) and drag handlers (lines 592-595) apply no touch-event filtering or event.preventDefault() guard, risking double-trigger on touch devices
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Three of five stress-test criteria fire — un-throttled slider redraws, no interrupt-safe position sync between transitions, and absent touch/mouse disambiguation — while infinite feedback loops and stale scale closures are clean.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view with restrained bundle opacity (0.18) and multiply blend-mode keeps 300 edges readable; the 10-color Tableau palette is near the warning threshold but perceptually distinct, and hover/click highlighting mitigates simultaneous color load — main unassessable risk is 200+ nodes simultaneously shape-morphing via flubber across 8 layout transitions.
